description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Onion Knight (Wind))] and [Black Magic Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode I (Onion Knight (Wind))
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic abilities trigger 2 additional times, causes [Imperil Wind 10% (5s)] after using two Black Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode II (Onion Knight (Wind))]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Black Magic Mode II (Onion Knight (Wind))
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Black Magic abilities, casts Dual Wind Sorcery after using Black Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Wind Sorcery
description.text: One single attack (16.92) capped at 99999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Attach Wind] to all allies with any Attach Wind

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Black Magic Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Black Magic abilities deal 5% more damage
